method: Full catalog Unicode, punctuation, spacing and OCR-pattern inventory with contextual review of flagged candidates.
Screened every existing short/full definition and its first rendered context; checked ambiguous aliases, selected adjacent paragraphs and targeted all-occurrence lists.
Compared Solar and other-reader vocabulary in context, rather than copying definitions automatically.
Opened independent sources for accepted new or revised claims. Existing sources were selectively checked, not universally recertified.
Used canonical authored annotation files and the reversible paragraph-addressed editorial ledger, then regenerated outputs.
limits: This is not an uninterrupted line-by-line rereading of all 2.75 million words or an exhaustive identification of every allusion.
No original EPUB was newly available for independent collation. High-confidence transcription repairs use local grammar, repeated canonical spellings and documented source-export context.
34 punctuation/Unicode recoveries with uncertain exact original wording remain deferred.
Native phone/Safari and print behavior are not claimed as tested.
